# ghost_organization_logo (Resource)

Sets an organization's logo, the avatar shown on its profile page. Only the organization's admins can set it.

The image is a PNG or JPEG of up to 2 MiB, from exactly one of `file` or `content_base64`. The provider hashes it at plan time (`content_sha256`), so changing the bytes uploads the new image in place. Creating the resource replaces any logo the organization already has, and destroying it removes the logo. A logo changed or removed outside Terraform shows up as drift.

`ghost_organization_settings` doesn't touch the logo, so the two can manage the same organization; the `ghost_organization` data source reads it back as `logo`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The logo from a local PNG or JPEG file (up to 2 MiB). The file is hashed at
# plan time, so editing it uploads the new image. Destroy removes the logo.
resource "ghost_organization_logo" "example" {
  organization = "my-org"
  file         = "${path.module}/logo.png"
}

# Or base64-encoded content:
#
#   content_base64 = filebase64("${path.module}/logo.jpg")
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The organization's slug, matched case-insensitively and kept as configured. Changing it to another organization forces a new resource (removing the old organization's logo); changing only its case doesn't.

### Optional

- `content_base64` (String) The PNG or JPEG image, base64-encoded, e.g. `filebase64("logo.png")`. It is stored in state. Conflicts with `file`.
- `file` (String) The path of a local PNG or JPEG file. It is read at plan time to work out `content_sha256`, so a changed file uploads the new image. A file that doesn't exist yet at plan time (one created during the apply) is read at apply time. Conflicts with `content_base64`.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) The hex SHA-256 of the image. A change uploads the new image. After an import, or when the logo was changed outside Terraform, it is computed by downloading the logo.
- `content_type` (String) The image's type, `image/png` or `image/jpeg`, detected from its first bytes.
- `id` (String) The organization's slug, in lower case.
- `size` (Number) The size of the image in bytes.
- `url` (String) The URL Ghost serves the logo from, the organization's `logo`. Each upload gets a new URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organization's logo is imported by the organization's slug. The import
# downloads the logo once to work out content_sha256.
terraform import ghost_organization_logo.example my-org
```
